title: Incorrect auto-envvar handling for empty lists
detail: The condition `if not envvar` treats an empty list (`[]`) as falsy, causing the code to generate an auto‑envvar name even when the user explicitly set `envvar=[]`. This violates the intended behaviour that an empty envvar should be treated as if no envvar was provided.
note: About the auto-envvar assignment above the planted line; the PR's own logic.

title: Missing handling of envvar sequences
detail: When `envvar` is a non‑string sequence (e.g., a list of variable names), the code falls through the `if isinstance(envvar, str)` branch and never adds the sequence to `extra['envvars']`. This results in the help text not showing any envvar hints for sequence values.
note: Says a sequence envvar is never added, which the planted `not` causes, but blames the isinstance branch: the mechanism is wrong.

title: Incorrect header normalization
detail: The logic sets any header whose name is not "content-type" to "Content-Type", overwriting all other headers. This causes arbitrary headers to be lost and the request to send only a single Content-Type header.
note: Says every header but Content-Type is renamed, which the planted `!=` does.
